statement.zh: 吉萨金字塔与神庙的早期科学测绘/发掘记述见 Petrie《吉萨金字塔与神庙》（1883）。
statement.en: At Giza, an early scientific survey/excavation account of the pyramids and temples is documented in Petrie The Pyramids and Temples of Gizeh (1883).
